title: IPACK and Adductor Canal Catheter Patient Outcomes for TKAs?
brief_summary: This study evaluates the addition of the IPACK block to the adductor canal block and catheter in the pain management of total knee arthroplasty. Half of participants will receive the adductor canal block and catheter with the IPACK block, while the other half will receive the adductor canal block and catheter only.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing total knee replacement without contraindications to regional blocks

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have contraindications to regional blocks: infection at injection site for the nerve block, allergy to local anesthetics, history of a bleeding disorder
